Definition: from G4123; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency, extortion:--covetous(-ness) practices, greediness.
BiblicalUsage: Pleonexia is covetousness, the greed that never says enough. Paul says to mortify it, for it is idolatry, in Colossians 3:5, and that it should not once be named among saints in Ephesians 5:3. Jesus warns, Take heed, and beware of covetousness, in Luke 12:15, and Romans 1:29 lists it among the sins of a mind God gave over.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe covetousness is the sin that dresses up as ambition and dies as idolatry. That is why I hold that the only safe amount of it is none.
